dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Thus did I foresee — \nwaves crashing on the shore, the night sky devoured by deathly silence."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Thus did I declare — \nwhomsoever cradles the flame and keeps it burning unquenched need not descend into that darkness."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Thus did I vow — \nour bones and blood we shall use as fuel, we shall make life greater than death."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"The winds awaken, the leaves whirl round,\nfree your heart from dreams of the living."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Our cheeks are pale, our hair does flutter, our eyes burn bright as flame."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"We shall part the snow-curtain of the sky, and blast the winter winds across the wasteland."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Monument
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"We are the Lightkeepers, who shine the eternal light of hope into the endless snow-swept plains."</color>
